heroHeadline: Brand Identity, Product Design & Website Development
heroSubheadline: Build a consistent brand, shape an intuitive product experience, or launch a website. BluJoy Labs brings design and development together, with scope and deliverables tailored to your project.
pathwaysHeading: What We Can Help You Create
pathwaysSubtitle: Choose support for your brand, product experience or website. We agree the deliverables and review points around the work you need.

pathways.title: Brand Identity & Visual Design
pathways.description: Create a consistent visual identity for your business. We design logos, colour palettes, typography and brand guidelines, with supporting materials such as presentation templates and marketing assets included according to your project scope.

pathways.title: Product & UX Design
pathways.description: Design clear, consistent experiences for web and mobile products. We translate your requirements into user flows, wireframes, interface designs and clickable prototypes. Reusable components, design systems and developer handoff documentation are included according to the agreed scope. Research and usability testing can be included in the project scope.

pathways.title: Website Design & Development
pathways.description: Design and build a website around your business goals. We create responsive websites with clear navigation and content management suited to your needs. Projects can include a new website, redesign, eCommerce storefront or implementation of an existing design. CMS development, Shopify/eCommerce and frontend implementation can be included in the agreed scope.

faqs.question: What services can we hire BluJoy for?
faqs.answer: We offer three core services: Brand Identity & Visual Design, Product & UX Design, and Website Design & Development. You can commission a single service or a combined engagement, and we'll agree the right scope for your project.

faqs.question: Can you use our existing brand or designs?
faqs.answer: Yes. We review your existing materials during scoping and can build on what you already have, or help evolve it if it's holding your product back.

faqs.question: Do you design for web and mobile?
faqs.answer: Yes. We design responsive websites and interfaces for web and mobile products. Mobile app development itself isn't part of a design engagement; we can connect you with AI Consulting for that.

faqs.question: Can you build a CMS website or online store?
faqs.answer: Yes. CMS builds and Shopify/eCommerce storefronts are part of Website Design & Development. We confirm features, integrations and platform costs during scoping.

faqs.question: What will we receive at handover?
faqs.answer: Design files, website deliverables, documentation and guidance are defined in your project scope, so you know exactly what to expect before work begins.

faqs.question: How are pricing and timelines determined?
faqs.answer: Both depend on scope, complexity, the materials you provide and how many review rounds are needed. We put together a fit-for-purpose quote after an initial conversation.

faqs.question: Do you provide support after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Maintenance and follow-on support can be scoped separately after launch. It isn't an included or unlimited service by default.

faqs.question: Can you help with AI features?
faqs.answer: For AI functionality, custom solutions or agent prototypes, we'll connect your project with AI Consulting to scope that work alongside your design and build.
